question: In a certain code language, REGULATION is written as QDFTKZSHNM. How will SYMPOSIUM be written as in that language?

Logic: By decreasing positional value by 1, as shown:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33de1e4cd435c781d80aa8cfaaa0a350aead2a381c42dc0d17ab27c8341d86e6.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7b4056d83aa6994880795d2236ad9601891815132928d2211f240a8a17fd4ef.png]
